title: Annotatio II §.V close: Torgau 1576 silent; Philippist Corpus out, Formula Concord body in; Bergen Fathers explain as potential — stop before §.VI
pass_a_gloss: silent in the later one of the year 1576 (in which, the Philippist Body of Doctrine having been abrogated, there succeeded in its place the New Body of Lutheran Doctrine still today comprehended in the Formula of Concord), and at last explained by the Bergen Fathers concerning the Potential — in the Solid Declaration and Explanation of the Controverted Articles, page (mine) 754, edition in quarto, year 1580.
pass_b_english: In the later Torgau meeting of 1576 it went silent — the year the Philippist Corpus Doctrinae was set aside and today's Formula of Concord body of Lutheran doctrine took its place.
At last the Bergen Fathers explained it as potential, in the Solid Declaration and Explanation of the Controverted Articles (my copy p. 754; 4to ed. 1580).
source_text: in posteriori, anni 1576. (in quo, Corpore Doctrinae Philippicô abrogatô, in ejus locum Novum hodieq; Formulâ Concordiae comprehensum Doctrinae Lutheranae Corpus successit) tacitam, tandemque à Patribus Bergensibus de Potentiali explicatam, in solid. Explicat. & Declarat. Artic. Controv. pag. mihi p. 754. Edit. in 4to. Anno 1580.
